propositions: not_a_bug close without --reason and without a replacement link incorrectly routes to the completion verifier, which demands proof of a fixed defect that never existed
close_disposition.verdict() returns None for not_a_bug (absent replacement link), causing fallthrough to full completion verification instead of accepting a deterministic reason-based disposition

not_a_bug and escalated must be added to REASON_REQUIRED_CLASSES so that --reason satisfies disposition (with live replacement links as precedent satisfiers), and close is refused at write time if neither is provided

A signed disposition attestation carrying (class, close_reason) must be minted and stored in the event + manifest without invoking the completion verifier, for bug closes with --class not_a_bug --reason and no --force
escalated has the same structural problem as not_a_bug (no in-repo defect fixed, completion verifier unpassable) and must be handled identically as reason-required with replacement-link precedence
